settings._notes: shown = idea chips offered per question at a time (picked at random). Prompts are keyed by check-in, then by question id from FORMS in js/app.js. hint replaces the placeholder text; pinned ideas are always shown first; ideas are tap-to-add phrases picked at random. Keep ideas short, doable, and guilt-free. Morning ideas are plans (present tense); night ideas look back (past tense).

ideas: Take five slow breaths when it shows up
Write it down and let it be
Take a short walk to reset
Put on music that matches my mood
Ask for help if I need it

Say it out loud to someone
